_comment: Spec 039-03 — a REDACTED, REAL-SHAPED (not real) multi-page fixture standing in for a container's gtag.js /g/collect session across an MPA. ADR-0020 R5: real captures are local-only and uncommittable; the measurement id, client/session ids, timestamps, and cookie values below are clearly-synthetic — no live identifier appears here. The session-state TRANSITION RULES encoded below were DIRECTLY OBSERVED on the intuit-class reference page (stage.erp.intuit.com, GA4 stream, 2026-09-08) by driving _ga_<stream> cookie transitions across reloads: (1) first visit mints cid + o1/g0/s=t=now; (2) continuation within 30min keeps s and o, flips g 0->1 on engagement, advances t; (3) a new session after a >30min inactivity gap increments o, mints a fresh s, resets g to 0, sets t=s. Beacon fields map from the GS2 cookie: sid<-s, sct<-o, seg<-g; _ss/_nsi present iff the beacon is the first of a NEW session; _fv present iff _ga was just minted. cid/sid are DERIVED from the cookies (never a beacon back-feed). gcs/gcd carry the LIVE-OBSERVED granted-consent Consent-Mode values (gcs=G111, gcd=13r3r3r3r5l1) — these are consent-defaults/state strings, not identifiers, so they are the real observed values, not synthesized; gcd derivation itself is slice 039-05's concern, gcs is 039-02's.

pages.label: page-1 first visit (new client, new session start)
page-3 new session (>30min inactivity gap → o increments, fresh sid, g reset)
